title: Derive key names from an as const object
statement:
1. Створи `export const STATUS = { ok: 200, created: 201, badRequest: 400, notFound: 404 } as const;`
2. Виведи `export type StatusName = keyof typeof STATUS;`
3. Напиши `statusName(code: number): StatusName | null` — назва для коду або `null`.

```ts
statusName(404);  // 'notFound'
statusName(500);  // null
```
